{"addr": "0x14054f349", "comment": "Each participant's graph gets PairEnd (IAnimationGraphManagerHolder vfunc 1); not taken -> PairedStop. The only sender of a mount's PairEnd: HorseBehavior MountBehavior DismountSynced/MountSynced leave on it alone. Measured (duo 2026-11-19): on the rider's game this runs in the same frame as the rider's Detach (41539), just before it. A copy horse gets it only from its owner's graph stream, as an event due with the owner's next update: co-op hands a horse back once that update is recorded and its ops sent, and the next owner takes it once its copy ran them (docs/re/systems/mounts.md). SkyrimCoop piece-4"}
